_doc: Cross-source evidence for RESULTS, one entry per attributable source per match. Extends the fixture-correction ledger's discipline (url + retrieved + exact supporting text, per FIELD) to result confirmation. An entry supports ONLY the fields it lists -- a source confirming a 3-1 result says nothing about box stats, broadcast, or availability. kind names the source class; 'ncaa_official' entries can never make a result cross-source CONFIRMED (a second NCAA endpoint is the same source wearing a different URL, and is never called independent). Joins are anchored on the explicit game id in this file plus the exact matchup/score in the supporting text -- a shared school name is not enough. A page that could not be verified (JS-rendered, no readable text) is recorded as attempted_unverifiable and stays PENDING, never confirmed. MACHINE observations live in result_evidence_auto.json (regenerated nightly by verify_results_daily.py; merged at read time by confidence.py, curated URL outranking auto); a validated auto conflict_observed is promoted HERE, by a human, as a real 'conflicts' entry.
